remarks: If you're seeking the convenience of a condo that lives like a welcoming home, this is it! 287 Hamilton Ave #5A is one of only two residences in the iconic converted farmhouse at the heart of Hamilton Green. Unique features include a front porch for curb appeal, a large lattice-screened porch for al fresco dining, and three fireplaces. The interior is filled with charm-hardwood floors (freshly refinished upstairs), fresh paint in a timeless palette, a wide staircase with vintage bannister, and an oversized upstairs hall ideal for a small office. The main level offers a light-filled living room with fireplace, formal dining room with second fireplace, and a sunny kitchen with crisp white cabinetry. Upstairs, the primary suite boasts the third fireplace, access to a rooftop deck, fitted closets, and a beautifully renovated bath, while a second bedroom completes the level. Additional conveniences include assigned parking, ample guest parking, basement storage, and shared laundry. Located near the Darien border with easy access to I-95, train stations,Cove Park Beach, and all the shopping, dining, and entertainment of downtown Stamford. Come see why this one-of-a-kind residence feels like home the moment you arrive.**BEST AND FINAL DUE ON MONDAY SEPTEMBER 15TH BY 5 PM. NO ESCALLATION CLAUSES.**
